value.strategy: The investment objective of the Trojan Fund is to seek to achieve growth in capital (net of fees), ahead of inflation (UK Retail Prices Index), over the longer term (5 to 7 years). The Fund has flexibility to invest globally in various asset classes, with no particular geographic focus, and exposure will be varied. It may invest directly in securities or indirectly through other funds. The Fund will invest in line with the Investment Manager’s Climate Change Mitigation Policy and may use derivatives for Efficient Portfolio Management, including hedging.
value.philosophy: The philosophy is centered on achieving long-term capital growth (5 to 7 years) ahead of inflation (UK Retail Prices Index), with a flexible, global, multi-asset approach. The Fund maintains flexibility in asset class exposure, including the use of derivatives for efficient portfolio management, and adheres to the Investment Manager’s Climate Change Mitigation Policy.
value.asset_types: Government and public securities (such as sovereign debt and treasury bills), corporate bonds, equities and equity-related securities, private equity, precious metals (indirect exposure), cash, cash equivalents (including money-market instruments) and deposits. The Fund may also invest in open-ended or closed-ended funds (including collective investment schemes, investment trusts, and exchange traded commodities) and use derivatives (currency forwards and futures).
value.real_objectives: To seek to achieve growth in capital (net of fees), ahead of inflation (UK Retail Prices Index), over the longer term (5 to 7 years).
